fixed.how: budget-pause.ts reads a relative-clause 'nothing' (RELATIVE_HEAD: 'nothing [that] the criteria require', 'nothing that the brief still needs'; a still or yet before the verb is not read as work). A general rule ends the patching one phrasing at a time: a one-clause line that starts with nothing or none, names the whole set (WHOLE_SET, not ONE_CRITERION), names no work (NOT_NOTHING) and states no state of the work (WORK_STATE) is empty. WRAP_UP_BRIEF_LINE and wrapUpText (both drivers) now ask for 'only the word nothing when they need nothing more'. ADR 0112 is amended and runtime.md updated.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Live (bench-live): a researcher task 'Compare three static site hosts ... write hosts.md' with a task budget below its estimate so it hears the wrap-up. If its report ends 'Left to do: nothing the criteria require.', the session page shows no 'paused before' or 'listed one thing left to do' line, the task is reviewed and Done in the same session, and the Inbox has no Continue card. In the model-call log, the brief ends its wrap-up line with "or only the word 'nothing' when they need nothing more; no optional extras". The stand-in cannot word the live line (role-player.ts is l4-chat-answers' file in L4c), so this step needs the real model (phase F's F-9).

fixed.how: runner.ts roomAfterPause decides what a pause at the session's work budget does. It ends the session with budget_exceeded on a hard stop or once the budget takes no new work. It ends with no budget stop ('Ended: 1 paused') when the room left is less than the smallest task after the larger one (queued or after_large). Otherwise the loop goes on, and the re-plan takes the after_large tasks that fit; a task that still does not fit stays after_large. waitsForNextSessionSentence says what the larger task left ('"B" (about CHF 0.06) waits for your next session: "X" left CHF 0.03 of this one.') from ResultFacts.workLeftChfMicro. It says 'used the rest' only below half a centime. The regression fix db2d5dd keeps a hard stop there ending the session (phase-1 gate, e2e scenario 5).
fixed.check_in_the_app: Live: session budget CHF 0.40. A researcher task larger than the work budget runs first, then a tagline task of about CHF 0.06. When the larger task wraps up and pauses with room left (e.g. CHF 0.23 spent), the tagline task starts and finishes in the same session. The session page and More > Sessions never read 'Stopped: the budget is used', 'The session's budget is used' or 'used the rest of this one' while the spend is under CHF 0.32. The status reads 'Ended: 1 paused', and the larger task has one Continue card. With a second task too big for what is left, the result reads '"B" (about CHF x) waits for your next session: "<larger>" left CHF y of this one.'
